unit.name: Unit 1
unit.summary: Cellar and first floor, with a rear deck and yard. One bedroom, one full bath, one half bath, and cellar rooms the plan marks as accessory use.
unit.source: Dimensions are read by eye from the sponsor's floor plan drawing, which says all dimensions are approximate. Measure on site before ordering anything.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.note: Counters run along the left wall with an island and sink.

rooms.name: Dining
rooms.note: Next to the kitchen and the doors to the deck. Plan notes 8'-9" ceiling.

rooms.name: Living room
rooms.note: Open to the dining area. Plan notes 8'-9" ceiling.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.note: Full bath: vanity at the rear end, a shower stall, then the toilet by the door. The shower walls below are estimated from the drawing.

rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.note: At the front of the house, with a closet.

rooms.name: Open deck
rooms.note: Concrete deck off the dining room, 14'-1" by 8'-0". Limited common element.

rooms.name: Rear yard
rooms.note: About 782 sq ft of pavers on grade with a raised garden and a metal trellis, plus a 47 sq ft areaway. Limited common element.

rooms.name: Cellar room, rear
rooms.note: Marked accessory use: no living, cooking or sleeping, and not to be rented. Plan notes 7'-0" ceiling.

rooms.name: Cellar room, front
rooms.note: Marked accessory use, with a closet. Plan notes 7'-0" ceiling.

rooms.name: Cellar powder room
rooms.note: Half bath with a toilet and sink.

rooms.name: Cellar laundry
rooms.note: Washer and dryer, with a closet.
